ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, above the part number line, printed ".431 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G1 BC, below the part number line, printed ".459 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, above the part number line, printed ".221 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

G7 BC, below the part number line, printed ".226 (O89)". Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. Page footnote: "Highlighted bullets were tested through the Oehler 43 system"; which bullets is not read. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .224, Grains 79, Minimum Required Twist *1-7", Part Number MTAC 224 79 MAX, G1 BC .431 (A.B.) / .459 (O89), G7 BC .221 (A.B.) / .226 (O89), OAL 1.185", Bullet Projection .773"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: .773".
